question: Who are all students currently in grade ten?
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM Highschooler WHERE grade = 10

question: What are the package options of TV channels 'Sky radio'?
reference_sql: SELECT Package_Option FROM TV_Channel WHERE series_name = "Sky Radio"

question: Show the list of the airlines and their abbreviations used in the United States.
reference_sql: SELECT Airline , Abbreviation FROM AIRLINES WHERE Country = "USA"

question: How many ships ended up being 'Captured'?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ship WHERE ship.is_captured = "T"

question: What are the names of countries that speak less than 2 languages, as well as how many languages they speak?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.Language) , T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*) < 2
historical_baseline_sql:
SELECT c.Name, COUNT(cl.Language) AS LanguageCount
FROM country AS c
LEFT JOIN countrylanguage AS cl ON cl.CountryCode = c.Code
GROUP BY c.Code, c.Name
HAVING COUNT(cl.Language) < 2;
canvas_sql:
SELECT c.Name, COUNT(cl.Language) AS LanguageCount
FROM country AS c
JOIN countrylanguage AS cl ON cl.CountryCode = c.Code
GROUP BY c.Code, c.Name
HAVING COUNT(cl.Language) < 2;

question: What is the name of the visitor who visited both a museum opened before 2009 and a museum opened after 2011?
reference_sql: SELECT visitor.first_name , visitor.last_name FROM visitor JOIN visit ON visitor.ID = visit.visitor_ID JOIN museum ON museum.Museum_ID = visit.Museum_ID WHERE museum.Open_Year < 2009 INTERSECT SELECT visitor.first_name , visitor.last_name FROM visitor JOIN visit ON visitor.ID = visit.visitor_ID JOIN museum ON museum.Museum_ID = visit.Museum_ID WHERE museum.Open_Year > 2011
historical_baseline_sql:
SELECT v.first_name || ' ' || v.last_name AS name
FROM visitor AS v
JOIN visit AS vi ON vi.visitor_ID = v.ID
JOIN museum AS m ON m.Museum_ID = vi.Museum_ID
GROUP BY v.ID, v.first_name, v.last_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(m.Open_Year AS INTEGER) < 2009 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(m.Open_Year AS INTEGER) > 2011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;
canvas_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT v.first_name, v.last_name
FROM visitor AS v
JOIN visit AS v_before ON v_before.visitor_ID = v.ID
JOIN museum AS m_before ON m_before.Museum_ID = v_before.Museum_ID
JOIN visit AS v_after ON v_after.visitor_ID = v.ID
JOIN museum AS m_after ON m_after.Museum_ID = v_after.Museum_ID
WHERE CAST(m_before.Open_Year AS INTEGER) < 2009
  AND CAST(m_after.Open_Year AS INTEGER) > 2011;

question: Find the name and rank of the 5 youngest winners across all matches.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT winner_name , winner_rank FROM matches ORDER BY winner_age LIMIT 5
historical_baseline_sql:
SELECT winner_name, winner_rank
FROM matches
WHERE winner_age IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY winner_age ASC
LIMIT 5;
canvas_sql:
SELECT winner_name, winner_rank
FROM matches
WHERE winner_age IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY winner_name, winner_rank
ORDER BY MIN(winner_age) ASC
LIMIT 5;

question: What are the record companies of orchestras in descending order of years in which they were founded?
reference_sql: SELECT orchestra.Record_Company FROM orchestra ORDER BY orchestra.year_of_existence asc

question: What are the different models created by either the car maker Honda or weighed more than 3500?
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Model = T2.Model JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T2.Maker = T3.Id JOIN CARS_DATA AS T4 ON T1.MakeId = T4.Id WHERE T3.FullName = 'Honda' OR T4.weight > 3500
historical_baseline_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ml."Model"
FROM "model_list" AS ml
JOIN "car_makers" AS cm ON cm."Id" = ml."Maker"
WHERE cm."Maker" = 'Honda'
   OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM "car_names" AS cn
       JOIN "cars_data" AS cd ON cd."Id" = cn."MakeId"
       WHERE cn."Model" = ml."Model"
         AND cd."Weight" > 3500
   );
canvas_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT cn.Model
FROM car_names AS cn
JOIN model_list AS ml ON ml.Model = cn.Model
JOIN car_makers AS cm ON cm.Id = ml.Maker
JOIN cars_data AS cd ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
WHERE cm.FullName = 'Honda'
   OR cd.Weight > 3500;

question: How many participants of the WTA have won this tournament is left-handed?
reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT winner_name) FROM matches WHERE tourney_name = 'WTA Championships' AND winner_hand = 'L'
canvas_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT winner_id)
FROM matches
WHERE tourney_name = 'WTA Championships'
  AND winner_hand = 'L';
